title: IES GLUT 2 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: IES GLUT 2 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: IES GLUT 2 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety for Luzon. 68 to 71 days to harvest, 5.5 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: IES GLUT 2 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2001 as NSIC 2001 Cn 135. CVIARC, Ilagan, Isabela bred it. It takes 68 to 71 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.54 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

IES GLUT 2 corn takes 68 to 71 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 27.6 days faster than the average of the 19 glutinous open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 97.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.54 t/ha beats the average of its group, 5.09. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant IES GLUT 2 corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon in both the wet and the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 68 to 71 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.54 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.
The registry recommends it for Luzon in both the wet and the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of IES GLUT 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
